about.en: Extended Vault Share (XVS) is the share token of the Extended Vault, issued when a user deposits USDC into the vault on the Extended perpetuals exchange. Its price accrues the vault's yield from liquidation processing, lending in Extended's money market and a share of exchange fees, and 90% of an XVS balance's value counts as trading collateral on Extended. XVS can be moved between Extended sub-accounts but not withdrawn from the exchange; it is unrelated to Venus (XVS).
